name: Terrain Generation via Noise
aliases: Terrain Generation via Noise — Exponential Perlin Noise Terrain Generation, Heightmap Terrain, Noise Terrain, Perlin Noise Terrain Generation, Perlin Noise for Terrain
definition: Generates voxel terrain heightmaps using 2D Perlin noise, filling voxels from y=0 up to the calculated height.
summary: Terrain Generation via Noise creates deterministic 3D voxel volumes from 2D Perlin noise heightmaps, distinguished by its focus on continuous height variation rather than discrete feature placement.
